items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: So we had Coco, myself, the bass and we had two fills and a viola and had Stan Reitzman on piano.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I took Candy went with, I took your cigarette. Yeah, Candy Candido, he quit to go with Ted Fiorita. And that's when Gene sent for me. And at the time, I was part owner of a nightclub. Out here, originally it was the Honeysuckle, and then it got to be the Golden Pumpkin. And the place in there, it was a summer place. It drew good in the summer. Winter wasn't no good at all because right under the lake it used to get a lot of fog out there. People wouldn't come out in the winter clubs. And they had to…

around $35 a week and I told them they didn't believe me. I told them I said well I didn't lie to you so far why should I lie to you about that? So it wound up that they fined Coco $250 and they fined a bass player $250 and Austin $1,000 and $1,100 they had to pay back. They didn't fined me a dime. So I got you know just by telling the truth I got by without having to pay anything. So with this place in the back that we played in the afternoon we played from 12 to 3. So we had Coco, myself, the bass and we had…
Well now where we go. I was wondering about when Mares came back from Chicago with the Rhythm Kings.
